methodology: Actual local embedding, query expansion and reranking. One per-query run for candidate10/20/40, in that order; later candidates reuse local expansion/reranker caches. Timings are descriptive, not controlled cold/warm benchmark claims. Only current AI-permitted source passages are mirrored; historical, non-AI-local and mutation cases are explicitly skipped here and covered by policy tests. Synthetic relevance labels are source-level, conventional recall/MRR/nDCG at5. Nearest-neighbor results for absent evidence are not asserted to establish facts; negative-query behavior is reported separately.
